title: Bovine Satellite Cell Pax7 Immunocytochemistry Protocol
author: Andrew Stout
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xx3fpqn
materials: Dilute primary antibodies in wash buffer and keep on ice (protected from light). For given antibody, use the following dilutions: anti-Pax7 (1:500) Phalloidin-594 (1:100) note* prepare enough antibody solution for all conditions (a little extra is usually good to make sure there is enough)
Add primary antibody solutions and incubate overnight at 4C (parafilm to avoid evaporation)

Dilute secondary antibodies in wash buffer and keep on ice (protected from light). For given antibody, use the following dilutions: 488 goat-anti-rabbit (1:500) note* prepare enough antibody solution for all conditions (a little extra is usually good to make sure there is enough)

steps.title: Fix cells with cold PFA
steps.instruction: Add cold 4 % paraformaldehyde to fully cover cells or scaffolds and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add enough cold 4 % PFA to cover cells or scaffolds.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash with room‑temperature PBS
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with room‑temperature PBS; optionally seal with parafilm and store at 4 °C for up to one week before staining.

substeps.instruction: Perform three consecutive washes with room‑temperature PBS.
If desired, seal plates with parafilm and refrigerate (4 °C) for up to 1 week before proceeding.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBS, add cold permeabilization solution, and incubate for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate all PBS from the wells.
Add cold permeabilization solution covering the cells.
Incubate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash with cold PBST
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with cold PBST.

substeps.instruction: Perform three consecutive washes with cold PBST.

steps.title: First cold wash buffer incubation
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBST, add cold wash buffer, and incubate for 45 minutes on ice (or cold).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the PBST solution.
Add cold wash buffer to cover the cells.
Incubate for 45 minutes while kept cold.

steps.title: Wash after first incubation
steps.instruction: After the 45‑minute incubation, wash cells three times with cold PBST.

substeps.instruction: Perform three consecutive washes with cold PBST.

steps.title: Second cold wash buffer incubation
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBST, add cold wash buffer, and incubate for 15 minutes on ice.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the PBST solution.
Add cold wash buffer.
Incubate for 15 minutes while kept cold.

steps.title: Add secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Aspirate wash buffer, add secondary antibody solution, and incubate in the dark at room temperature for 60 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the wash buffer from the cells.
Add the appropriate secondary antibody solution.
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Post‑antibody washes
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with cold PBST, letting the final wash soak for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Perform three washes with cold PBST.
Allow the last wash to remain on the cells for 5 minutes before aspiration.

steps.title: Mount with DAPI and image
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBST, add DAPI mounting medium, cover with a coverslip, and acquire images after 10 minutes (Pax7 = green, actin = red, nuclei = blue).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the final PBST wash.
Add DAPI mounting medium to the cells.
Place a coverslip over the sample.
Wait 10 minutes, then image (Pax7 green, actin red, nuclei blue).
